title: Design System: Food Label Health Agent

display.purpose: One promise in the first viewport.

measurement.purpose: Confidence, dates, units, and provenance only.

motion.name: proof-settle
motion.purpose: Uploaded evidence settles into its optical room.

components.name: Correction Field
components.description: Editable OCR field with visible uncertainty.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;color:#1D1D1F;font:650 12px SFMono-Regular,monospace}.ds-field textarea{min-height:92px;border:1px solid rgba(29,29,31,.24);border-radius:14px;padding:13px 14px;color:#1D1D1F;background:#fff;font:450 16px/1.55 -apple-system,sans-serif}.ds-field textarea:focus{outline:4px solid rgba(0,113,227,.25);border-color:#0071E3}

components.name: Optical Bento Room
components.description: A high-priority workflow room carrying a full optical field.

components.name: State Pill
components.description: Compact workflow state, never a risk conclusion by color alone.

narrative.overview: Food-label evidence becomes a small set of calm, touchable rooms. Spacious composition and optical fields serve an operational upload-and-confirm workflow.
keyCharacteristics: One dominant label-input room before recognition; correction appears only when it has content.
Uploaded evidence is the visual hero.
Large consumer language leads; evidence metadata stays available but quiet.
Safety states always combine symbol, label, and explanation.

rules.name: The Whole-Field Rule
rules.body: Blue and violet carry whole inspection regions; semantic colors only communicate named states.

rules.name: The Plain-Language Rule
rules.body: Consumer meaning is large and immediate; technical metadata never visually leads.

rules.name: The Evidence Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation belongs to the evidence currently being inspected, not every container.

dos: Do let one meaningful image or task dominate each viewport.
Do use unequal Bento rooms to communicate priority.
Do reveal correction controls only after recognition succeeds.
Do keep uncertainty visible before interpretation.
donts: Don't copy Apple imagery or proprietary assets.
Don't turn every fact into an equal card.
Don't expose roadmap stages or Agent routing to consumers.
Don't imply medical clearance or absolute safety.
